import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,re,subprocess,sys,base64
p=Path.cwd();ids=set(json.loads((p/'reservation.json').read_text())['ids'])
def w(n,s):
 r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),n],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
rows=[]
cor=p.parents[1]/'lanes/pi-mathdb-full-corpus-inventory-r301/corpus'
for f in sorted(cor.glob('mathdb-normalized-chunk-*.jsonl')):
 data=f.read_bytes();h=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
 for ln,raw in enumerate(data.splitlines(keepends=True),1):
  o=json.loads(raw);i=o.get('mathdb_id',o.get('id'))
  if i not in ids:continue
  print('RECORD',i,json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False))
  tok=re.search(rb'"statement"\s*:\s*("(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*")',raw)
  rows.append(dict(id=i,chunk=str(f),chunk_sha256=h,line=ln,raw_b64=base64.b64encode(raw).decode(),raw_sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),newline=raw.endswith(b'\n'),statement_token=tok.group(1).decode() if tok else None,statement_token_sha256=hashlib.sha256(tok.group(1)).hexdigest() if tok else None,record=o))
assert len(rows)==20
for r in rows:
 st=r['record']['statement'];r['decoded_statement_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(st.encode()).hexdigest()
w('original-bindings.json',json.dumps(rows,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
